summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk with explicit stack, 4-cell indent per level, max_width passed unchanged). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint using the measured maximum (min with explicit width), and the new public VerticalCenter class (JupyterMixin, render with pad=False, newline-segment padding from console.size.height, delegated measurement, repr). rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the print render options while the collected-renderables call keeps the justify argument. CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 is marked Unreleased with an Added section (two entries; markdown entry kept). Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render/tall/measure, Align width) and tests/test_tree.py (acceptance tree Measurement(11, 19), single-node). Nothing was run: tests are unverified, per instructions. No commits made.
